acceptance.given: A Toolchain TC-D1 write request targets a Hosted workspace boundary.

oracle.expected: The boundary check emits a rejection and no Hosted workspace path is modified.
forbidden: Replay or Consumer permission authorizes Hosted workspace repair.
oracle.observable: The Toolchain boundary-policy result and filesystem write set are inspected during validation.

acceptance.then: The request is rejected before any Hosted workspace write occurs.
acceptance.when: During Toolchain write-scope validation, the proposed target path is classified.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject TC-D1 write requests targeting Hosted workspace boundaries and prevent replay or Consumer permission from authorizing those writes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing governance-policy decisions; add only the Hosted workspace boundary rejection.

slice_hint.state_transition: proposed Hosted workspace write -> rejected with no mutation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Boundary validation returns rejection and confirms no Hosted workspace path was written.

acceptance.given: Matrix evidence is classified as infrastructure-failed for at least one required case.

oracle.expected: Aggregate evaluation is marked invalid and cannot be accepted.
forbidden: Acceptance proceeds despite infrastructure-failed matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation result and acceptance eligibility field are inspected after matrix evaluation.

acceptance.then: The aggregate transitions to invalid and acceptance is blocked.
acceptance.when: After matrix execution records an infrastructure-failed case, aggregate evaluation computes its terminal verdict.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject infrastructure-failed matrix evidence and assert aggregate invalidation plus blocked acceptance.

affected_subjects: Aggregate evaluation with infrastructure-failed matrix evidence
slice_hint.behavior_change: Invalidate aggregate results whenever required matrix evidence is infrastructure-failed and prevent acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate result schema; map infrastructure-failed matrix evidence to invalid terminal status.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate evaluated with infrastructure-failed case -> invalid, non-acceptable
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate result is invalid and acceptance eligibility is false when any required matrix evidence is infrastructure-failed.

acceptance.given: An unexecuted matrix case is presented to success evaluation.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success result and cannot contribute success to the aggregate.
forbidden: Success is accepted for the unexecuted case.
oracle.observable: The case-level terminal result and aggregate success decision are inspected.

acceptance.then: Success is rejected for the unexecuted case.
acceptance.when: The semantic gate evaluates matrix evidence whose execution marker is absent or false.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a matrix case without execution evidence and assert a non-success case result and rejected aggregate success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject success for any matrix case lacking execution evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: unexecuted case presented -> non-success case result and aggregate rejection
